subject: GreenPay marketplace listing - security & certification checklist
messages:
From: John Sanders <john.sanders@greenpay.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing - security package needed for GreenPay evaluation

Hi Aditya,

We're preparing our Cloud Marketplace procurement package and GreenPay's security team needs the following artifacts to complete the evaluation for Redwood's listing:

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) or a SOC2 summary if full report is restricted
- Penetration test letter (attestation or executive summary) covering public cloud deployment
- Standard DPA (we will redline if needed) and confirmation of data residency controls
- Network/IP allowlist ranges for integration testing (if applicable)
- Contact for a short technical security call next week (30–45 min)

Can you share what you have available and an estimated timeline? We're on a condensed procurement schedule and would like to get these artifacts into our vendor portal by 2026-05-25.

Thanks,
John Sanders
Procurement Manager, GreenPay
procurement@greenpay.com

(Attachment: procurement-checklist-template.xlsx)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: john.sanders@greenpay.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing - security package needed for GreenPay evaluation

John —

Thanks for the clear list. We're good to support the marketplace submission on this timeline. Quick plan and owners below: 

- SOC 2 Type II: full SOC2 report is restricted, but we can provide a SOC2 executive summary and the auditor letter. Owner: Laura Bennett. ETA: EOD 2026-05-19.
- Pen test: we have a vendor attestation/letter from 2025 and a short scope note. Owner: Sergio Alvarez. ETA: 2026-05-19.
- DPA: we can provide our standard DPA and also create a redline for GreenPay; legal will prepare DocuSign. Owner: Priyom Das. ETA: 2026-05-20 (signed copy aimed by 2026-05-21).
- Network/IP ranges & integration notes: engineering can produce an allowlist and guidance doc. Owner: Sergio. ETA: 2026-05-20.
- Security call: happy to schedule — propose Wed 2026-05-20 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET (30 min). Please confirm.

I've attached a short SOC2 extract (redacted) to get you started; final artifacts will be uploaded to the secure Drive link and we'll share the DocuSign DPA when signed.

Next steps: I'll loop Laura and Priyom to upload final files to the Drive folder and trigger the DocuSign envelope.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
(Attachment: SOC2-extract-2025.pdf (summary, redacted))

From: John Sanders <john.sanders@greenpay.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greenpay.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing - security package needed for GreenPay evaluation

Aditya —

Thanks for the quick reply and the extract — that helps. Two quick clarifications from our security team: 

1) Data residency: can you confirm whether any customer data used during inference is persisted in the EU for EU customers? We need a short statement on data-at-rest locations per region.
2) Pen test scope: GreenPay requires that the pen test covers network and app-layer tests against production-ish endpoints. The 2025 letter — does it include cloud-hosted endpoint testing or is it limited to on-prem?

If you can provide short answers and the remaining artifacts by EOD 2026-05-19, we'll upload to our vendor portal and proceed. Also yes to the security call — 2026-05-20 10:00am PT works for us.

Cheers,
John

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing - security package needed for GreenPay evaluation

John —

Thanks for the call confirmation. Quick answers and attachments below: 

1) Data residency: Redwood persists customer data according to customer configuration and region. For EU customers who elect EU-only hosting, data-at-rest remains in EU regions only; for multiregional customers we provide clear documentation and a choice to pin workloads. Short statement attached.

2) Pen test scope: our 2025 pen-test letter covers cloud-hosted endpoints and application-layer testing against staging and production-facing infrastructure. Scope excerpt attached. Any additional scope GreenPay needs, we can discuss in the technical call.

Attached files (PDF stubs):
- SOC2-TypeII-2025.pdf (executive summary + auditor letter)
- pen-test-letter-2025.pdf (attestation and scope excerpt)
- DPA-GreenPay-signed.pdf (executed standard DPA copy)

Drive folder with all artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_redwood_security_pack
DocuSign envelope (reference): https://app.docusign.com/GreenPay/DPA/RGD-4127

If anything else is needed before the portal upload, let us know — otherwise we'll assume this is sufficient and you can proceed.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Trust & Compliance — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
(Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-2025.pdf (stub); pen-test-letter-2025.pdf (stub); DPA-GreenPay-signed.pdf (stub))
